title: Distance between binary matrix characters
statement: Let $A$ and $B$ be square matrices of size $n$ over the field with two elements, and associate to each matrix its character given by the sum of the entrywise products with the input matrix. Their relative Hamming distance is $0$ if $A=B$ and $1/2$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ and $B$ are matrices indexed by $\{1,\ldots,n\}\times\{1,\ldots,n\}$ over $\mathbb F_2$
